name: dockerfile-check
title: Dockerfile Check
description: Parses like BuildKit (escape directive, continuations, heredocs, stages) and flags a final image running as root, secrets in ARG or ENV, secret files baked in or copied across stages, COPY . before installs, no .dockerignore, apt-get hygiene, unchecked ADD URLs, curl | sh.

meta.stops: Docker image runs as root with secrets
meta.summary: Reads a Dockerfile the way BuildKit does and flags images that run as root, bake in secrets or rebuild slowly.
meta.server: Run image scanning and policy checks in CI; this check doesn't see the built image.
catches: A final stage that runs as root
Secrets in ARG or ENV, and secret files copied in or carried by COPY --from
COPY . before dependency install (slow rebuilds) and a missing .dockerignore
ADD from a URL without --checksum, curl | sh and shell-form CMD
limits: Static reading of the file; it doesn't build the image or scan installed packages
Base-image vulnerabilities are out of scope
a11y: Visible <label>; aria-invalid and aria-describedby to a role="status" summary
Jumping to a finding focuses the textarea at that line
After a fix, focus moves to the next fix or back to the field
